- **Styling**: Global Tailwind styles in `app/globals.css`. Docusaurus has its own theme in `textboo
- **Hybrid App**: Combines a Next.js web app (marketing, auth, dashboard) with a Docusaurus document

content.value_statement: New contributors can struggle to locate application code and understand how services connect. This skill provides a concise map of the stack, directories, integration patterns, and development commands.
actual_capabilities: Lists the documented Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Docusaurus, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle ORM stack.
Explains the purpose of the app, components, lib, db, drizzle, and textbook directories.
Identifies the documented Better Auth client and server configuration files.
Describes the shared authentication pattern between the web app and documentation site.
Provides the documented commands for starting the root app, documentation app, or both.
limitations: It describes only the architecture documented in SKILL.md.
It does not inspect the current repository or verify that paths still exist.
It does not provide database credentials, deployment settings, or runtime diagnostics.
It does not replace code review or security review of the application.

use_cases.title: Onboard a new contributor
use_cases.description: Use the directory map to find application code, authentication files, database logic, and documentation sources.

use_cases.title: Plan a feature change
use_cases.description: Review the documented boundaries before deciding whether a feature belongs in the web app or documentation site.

use_cases.title: Prepare technical documentation
use_cases.description: Use the stack and integration summary as a starting point for an architecture overview.

prompt_templates.title: Get a quick overview
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this project architecture in simple terms. Name the main applications and technologies.

prompt_templates.title: Find the right directory
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to change authentication behavior. Which documented directories and files should I review first?

prompt_templates.title: Understand application integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how the Next.js app and Docusaurus site share authentication state. List the documented limitations of this description.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an architecture review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an architecture review checklist from this skill. Separate documented facts from items that require repository verification.

output_examples.input: Where should I look for database schema and migrations?
output: Database schema and connection logic are documented in /db.
Verify the current repository before making changes.

output_examples.input: How do I start the applications during development?
output: Start the root app with npm run dev:root.
Start the documentation app with npm run dev:docs.
Start both applications with npm run dev.

best_practices: Verify the documented paths against the current repository before editing files.
Use the directory map to narrow investigation, then read the relevant implementation files.
Keep architecture documentation updated when directories or integration patterns change.
anti_patterns: Do not treat this skill as a complete inventory of every project file.
Do not assume documented commands are safe for every environment without checking package scripts.
Do not infer security guarantees from the architecture summary alone.

faq.question: What does this skill describe?
faq.answer: It describes the documented technology stack, directory structure, integration patterns, and development commands.

faq.question: Does it inspect my repository?
faq.answer: No. It uses the information documented in the skill file and does not inspect repository contents.

faq.question: Which web framework is documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents Next.js 15 with the App Router.

faq.question: Which documentation system is documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents a Docusaurus site in the textbook directory.

faq.question: Does it explain authentication?
faq.answer: It identifies Better Auth configuration and the documented shared authentication state between the two applications.

faq.question: Can it replace a security review?
faq.answer: No. Use a dedicated security review to assess code, configuration, dependencies, and runtime behavior.
